flattenedTasks.title: Stand-up
flattenedTasks.description: Check-in: describe your focus and any blocker. Do not supply external evidence.

flattenedTasks.title: Team presentation architecture
flattenedTasks.description: Learn to structure one coherent client narrative across several speakers.
flattenedTasks.v2_learning_goal: Understand presentation flow, handoffs, transitions and presentation timing.
flattenedTasks.v2_lesson_content: Plan an audience-focused argument, align demo moments with claims, and rehearse the transitions together.
v2_competency_criteria: Explain the purpose of a handoff

flattenedTasks.title: Build and deploy
flattenedTasks.description: Deploy the product, verify its key workflow and provide the deployed application URL.

flattenedTasks.title: Team storyboard
flattenedTasks.description: Create a team-authored storyboard document connecting the client narrative, demo and handoffs. Submit the real document link.

flattenedTasks.title: Dry-run reflection
flattenedTasks.description: Reflect on presentation timing and transitions. Discuss what you would check in a deployment rehearsal; no artifact requested.
questions: Which handoff would you practice next?

flattenedTasks.title: Loom walkthrough
flattenedTasks.description: Record a Loom walkthrough of the product and share the real video link.
flattenedTasks.v2_learning_goal: Connect the presentation flow to the audience's decision.

flattenedTasks.title: Retro
flattenedTasks.description: Reflect on how the shared client narrative and handoffs affected presentation clarity. State one next step.
